name: Taman (Indonesia)

earlier_scan.note: Glottolog inline refs are classification-only (Adelaar 2005); Wikipedia stub has no phonology; searches for a Taman/Tamanic phonology found nothing reachable

readall_conflicts: For the sister dialect Embaloh there is a known disagreement already held by the project under emba1238: Adelaar 1995 states fixed, non-distinctive penultimate stress, whereas Irawan et al. 2024 (Issues in Language Studies 13(1), instrumental study) find fixed final-syllable stress and explicitly say this differs from Adelaar 1995. Whether either finding carries over to Taman is not established by any source.

sources.citation: Irawan, Yusup et al. 2024. A lexical and post-lexical prosodic documentation of Embaloh language. Issues in Language Studies 13(1): 22-40. doi:10.33736/ils.6025.2024
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Sister language EMBALOH only (emba1238): instrumental finding of fixed final stress; reports Adelaar 1995 as penultimate. Says nothing about Taman.

Sec. 3.1 gives a phoneme inventory only for 'Sekadau Taman' (a Malayic variety, not tama1335); secs. 3.2/4 treat 'Tamanic Taman' (= tama1335) sound correspondences after Adelaar 1994 and vowel length from CV elision (ku:t, kai:, lai:). No word-stress statement for either variety.
